chapter.verse: Khazih in eite suahtakna thu i ngah nadingin hong suaktasak hi. Tua ahih ciangin kipin om un la, sila suahna hakkol pua-in, kikhihna zangkik nawn kei un.
En-un, keimah Paul in kong geninah, vunatna na thuak uh leh, Khazih hangin bangmah noptuamna na ngah kei ding uh hi.
Tua bang ahi hi. Vunatna a thuak mi khempeuh teci ka pankik inah, tua bang mite in Thukham khempeuh siit loin a zuih nadingin leiba nei mi ahi uh hi.
Thukham hangah diktan’sakna a ngah nuam note in, Khazih tawh kikhenin, ama hehpihna pan na puk zo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kote in upna tawh dikna ngah ding ci-in lamenin Kha Siangtho tung tawnin ngakin ka om uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih Zeisu sungah vunatna in phattuamna a om kei hi, vunat lohna in zong phattuamna a om kei hi; itna tawh nasep theihna upna bek in phattuamna a om hi.
Nidangin note in a pha takpi-in na tai uh hi. Thuman thutak na ngaih loh nadingun a kua in hong kheem hiam?
Hih kheemna zolna in note hong sampa kiang pan piang ahi kei hi.
Silngo tawm khat in annel lom a vekpi a tawksak thei hi.
Note in lungsim tuamdang na nei kei ding uh hi ci-in keimah in Topa sungah note tawh kipawlin upna taktak ka nei hi. Note hong khelbawl mi in kuakua ahih hangin ama mawhna dan a thuak ding hi.
Ka ute naute aw, kei ka hih leh, vunatna thu ka hilh lai leh, a bang hangin bawlsiatna ka thuak hiam? Tua bang ka hilh leh, singlamteh tawh kipawl pukna thu in paihkhiatna a thuak zo hi.
Note hong khialsak mite in amaute mah kiget ta uh hen ka ci hi!
Ute naute aw, note in suahtakna thu ngah dinga hong sap mi na hih uh leh, si-le-sa nopsak na’ngin tua suahtakna zang kei un. Ki-itna tawh khat leh khat’ nasem mi na suak zaw un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Na pumpi na it bangin na lawmte na it in,” a cihna thukham na zuih uh leh, Thukham khempeuh a zui khin na suak uh hi.
Ahih hangin khat leh khat na kipeh, na kinek uh leh, khat leh khat na kisiasak ding uh hi ci-in lunghimawhin kikem un.
Ke’n kong cihinah, Kha Siangtho hangin na nungta un. Na nuntak uh leh, na si-le-sa uh deihna zui loin na om ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, si-le-sa in Kha Siangtho tawh kido hi. Kha Siangtho in si-le-sa tawh kido hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na sep nop uh bangin na sep theih loh nadingun tuate nih in khat leh khat kilem lo uh hi.
Kha Siangtho in note hong kha leh, thukham nuaiah na om kei uh hi.
Si-le-sa’ gamtatnate a kilang zo hi. Tua gamtatnate in: numei tawh mawhna, kihhuai gamtatna, lunggulh luat khialhna,
milim biakna, mibumna, kitot na’ng bawlna, kitotna, kidemna, hehna, kiseelna, kithutuah lohna, kipawl khenna
en’na, zukham luatna, pawikhamna akipan tua bang gamtatnate ahi uh hi. Tau banga gamta mite in Pasian’ Gam a luah kei ding uh hi ci-in nidanga kong cih mah bangin tu-in zong ka hong ci khol hi.
Kha Siangtho’ gah in: itna, lungdamna, kilemna, lungduaina, mi hehpihna, gitna, diktatna,
lungnemna, pumpi’ deihna khamna te ahi uh hi. Tua bangin a gamta mite thukham in a kham kei hi.
Khazih Zeisu’ aa-te in si-le-sa’ deihna leh lunggulhnate singlamteh tungah a khencip zo uh hi.
Eite in Kha Siangtho hangah nungta i hih leh, Kha Siangtho hangin gamta ni.
Khat leh khat kibawlsiatna, khat leh khat kihazatna tangin mawkna minthan’nate lunggulhin om kei ni.
